title: smoke test: psp-etl analyze
description: Augment tests/test_cli_analyze.py. Existing tests cover the basics but use artificial blob content. Add: (1) a pipeline smoke test that starts from real blobs written by real analyze_blob() (not hand-crafted bytes) — create a blob with a known ASCII string, run analyze, verify score > 0. (2) verify --reanalyze actually overwrites stale scores. (3) verify 'Analyzed N unique blob(s).' summary line is present in output. All tests use --data-dir tmp_path.
